title: Chapter 57 Punishment
content:
Chapter 57 Punishment

Wang Shuo came to the construction site and saw that the project was progressing slowly. A few people were still dawdling after seeing him. He was furious, but his face did not show any abnormality.

He held back. He had to prevent these people from sticking together.

Wang Shuo smiled and said to the people kindly: "You have worked hard! We will make roasted whole lamb to reward you later."

Then he said to Suo Yong: "Suo Yong, come with me."

Wang Shuo found that Suo Yong's loyalty did not decrease, and even increased by 2 points to 83 points.

When he came to the hall, Wang Shuo sat on his throne at the top of the hall.

"It seems that the construction of the residential buildings today is not going well. Did something happen?"

Suo Yong's heart tightened and his breathing became rapid.

"Don't be nervous. I have seen your performance today. Don't doubt that I have my own way to detect all the big and small affairs in the territory."

"I plan to formally set up a craftsman camp and let you be the manager. Do you have confidence?"

Suo Yong was relieved. It turned out that the lord was not going to punish him, but promoted him in disguise?

Although this position was not attractive to him for the time being, a mosquito is still meat!

So he walked out happily and asked Hua Tianxiong to go in.

Hua Tianxiong's loyalty still dropped by 3 points, and now it is only 79 points.

But Wang Shuo did not intend to punish him. He also chatted with him about family matters, and finally said some words of praise to him and encouraged him to work hard.

One after another, each of the people in the territory went in and talked to Wang Shuo alone.

Most of the players came out with smiles on their faces.

Finally, it was Mao Qiang's turn.

After entering, Wang Shuo directly ordered him to kneel down.

This made him furious.

Mao Qiang's face flushed, and he said threateningly, "Who do you think you are?"

"Haha, I'll let you know." Wang Shuo smiled.

"How dare you disrespect the Lord!" Gong Zheng shouted and rushed directly to Mao Qiang, punching him in the face with a fist as big as a sandbag.

Mao Qiang did not get a combat profession, and his attributes were very different from Gong Zheng, who had already changed his profession to become a cavalryman. They were not at the same level at all.

He was knocked to the ground with just one blow.

Then he was beaten with fists and feet, and he had no power to fight back, and he kept screaming.

Mao Qiang yelled hysterically, "Wang Shuo, do you know who I am? My father is..." Before he could finish, he was hit in the mouth by a slap, and he was speechless!

The sound of fighting and scolding in the house made the people outside panic.

At this time, Guliji also said to his two followers: "It seems that someone has reported that Mao Qiang has published reactionary remarks and wants to rebel. How miserable!"

"I warn you two, don't tell anyone about this!"

After saying that, she turned and left with a mysterious smile on her face.

Not long after, the news spread among the people, and everyone looked gloating.

In the hall, Mao Qiang had been beaten black and blue, and his health was only 200 points.

At this moment, he regretted it very much. When Wang Shuo arrested him yesterday, he did not use heavy hands, which made him have the illusion that Wang Shuo was a weak and bullied person.

He was full of fear and was very afraid that Wang Shuo would kill the chicken to scare the monkey.

A dead person can only shock for a while, but he can continue to shock if he is alive.

"Lord, I was wrong, I will never dare to do it again." Mao Qiang began to beg for mercy desperately.

"The death penalty can be avoided, but the living crime cannot be forgiven. Are you willing to accept the punishment?"

"Yes, yes, yes!" Mao Qiang said hurriedly, his voice weak and powerless, no longer arrogant as before.

"Hang him outside for a day as a punishment."

Gong Zheng and the other two immediately set up a wooden frame outside, tied Mao Qiang's hands and hung him up!

Seeing Mao Qiang's miserable condition, everyone was terrified.

Then he called out the four people whose loyalty was less than 60.

In public, he shouted loudly: "According to reports, Ayireti, Jani, Wen Hongpeng, Bai Jixu, the four of you, together with Mao Qiang, made reactionary remarks and intended to harm Wana Village. Now you four will be punished with ten lashes. Do you accept it?"

"Lord, I am innocent!" Although the few people were a little scared, they still refused to accept it.

Wang Shuo snorted coldly and said sternly: "You said you were wronged in front of me. I am giving you a chance to admit your mistakes!"

"I have talked to all my subjects. There will always be some people who will report you. Your crimes are not serious. I have already given you the lightest punishment. If you don't accept it, I will find the person who pointed it out. Then, you will suffer the same fate as Mao Qiang!" Wang Shuo shouted angrily, which frightened several people.

"Lord, spare my life!" The four people's faces changed and they immediately knelt down to beg for mercy.

"Since you have confessed, then give them a small punishment and a big warning!"

At this time, other subjects were speculating who had reported the secret.

Looking around, they saw that everyone looked like an informer, and they would never trust others easily again.

In fact, Wang Shuo was not afraid of the lack of people to point out. Now he dared not disobey anyone Mao Qiang pointed out, and there were several of his own people, so he was naturally fearless.

After whipping these four people ten times, Wang Shuo did not pursue the matter anymore.

In a short period of time, no one dared to openly oppose him!

After this incident, the loyalty of the four refugees just captured started at 90 when they joined the territory.

This really made Wang Shuo speechless. This kind of evil behavior is enough to do it once. In fact, I want to be a good person!

After dealing with the possible rebellion risks within, Wang Shuo announced in front of everyone: "Formally establish the Artisan Camp, appoint Suo Yong as the manager of the Artisan Camp, responsible for the construction of the territory."

Suo Yong immediately walked out of the crowd, looked around, with a little pride on his face, and said solemnly: "I will definitely live up to the trust of the lord and guarantee to complete the tasks assigned by the lord."

At this time, someone took the lead in applauding, and the atmosphere began to warm up.

Wang Shuo then said: "Wana Village is newly built and there is a lot of work to be done. As long as everyone works together, we will be able to build a beautiful home."

"As long as people are outstanding and actively contribute to the development of the village, I will never treat them unfairly."

After arranging the affairs of the territory, Wang Shuo set out again to explore the area east of Wana Village.

Only 10 minutes after setting off, Wang Shuo arrived at the Xiangshui River.

The cliffs on both sides of the Xiangshui River are steep, with jagged rocks and few shoals. Wang Shuo walked along the river for a long time before he found a natural port.

On the riverside, Wang Shuo also found traces of someone making a raft. It is unknown whether the person who made the raft successfully crossed the Xiangshui River.

After all, the water in most parts of the Xiangshui River is very turbulent, and only the location that can be used as a port is the water slightly calmer.
